.github/workflows/build-apk.yml: Builds the signed release APK; publishes artifact, rolling latest release and metadata.
.github/workflows/maps-check.yml: Fails if any MAP.md is stale or a file lacks a description (npm run maps:check).
.github/workflows/supabase-keepalive.yml: Periodic ping that keeps the Supabase project active.
.github/workflows/telegram-public-releas: Manual dispatch: sends the ready APK to the Telegram channel.
